weekly.headline: 1,100 Microsoft fixes — and Nvidia without a CEO
weekly.intro: Microsoft shipped its second four-digit patch load of the year in the same week Nvidia lost the only CEO it has ever had.

themes.title: Patch Tuesday hits 1,100 CVEs and an Outlook 0-day
themes.takeaway: Prioritise the Outlook zero-day and 63 critical flaws this cycle, and patch Git clients too — six new vulnerabilities hit recursive clones and merges.
themes.detail: Microsoft's November drop fixes almost 1,100 flaws across Windows and supported software, including a zero-day already being used against Outlook. Separately, the Git project disclosed six vulnerabilities in reference handling, binary patches and imports, and FortiGuard Labs documented a campaign brute-forcing MS SQL Server logins and abusing T-SQL to drop Gh0st RAT and a Monero miner.

themes.title: AI agents need a blast radius, not a kill switch
themes.takeaway: Decide where agents execute and what they may write before rollout: microVM isolation and memory-write validation are becoming the enforced boundary, not the policy document.
themes.detail: Docker published guidance on Sandboxes — microVMs with their own kernel and private engine — versus plain containers for agent workloads, and AWS detailed multi-layer write validation to stop memory poisoning in Bedrock AgentCore. Palo Alto Networks is in talks to buy agent-identity startup Clutch for $500M, Cisco is adding Anthropic's Claude Mythos to AI Defense for red teaming, and United Airlines is simply blocking third-party agents from booking.

themes.title: Nvidia loses its CEO mid-buildout
themes.takeaway: GPU roadmaps, pricing and open-source commitments now sit with an interim chief under congressional scrutiny — build slack into hardware and capacity plans.
themes.detail: Jensen Huang is out after reporting on an affair with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, named in a US intelligence memo as recruited by China's Ministry of State Security, followed by a second alleged affair with a subordinate. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and Huang has agreed to testify before Congress. The $12.9B Hugging Face acquisition and Nvidia's open-weight model advocacy are now in question.

themes.title: Data center backlash now shapes capacity plans
themes.takeaway: Expect slower and pricier regional capacity: voters backed restrictions in 40 of 41 data center ballot measures and protesters breached Microsoft's Amsterdam construction site.
themes.detail: Permitting delays, local opposition and power constraints mean many announced projects will never be built. SoftBank booked over $3B in losses on preordered gas turbines, CoreWeave is funding growth through customer prepayments and shorter contracts, and OpenAI has dropped NDAs with public officials on data center projects.
